<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Echo Med Lab''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー基地医務室</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">１ターンに１回、自分の医療用ドロイドを１台、－２で配備できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、この場所に帝国軍がいるなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Hoth-Echo-Med-Lab-SWCA-100687.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Echo Med Lab.

'''Light Side:'''
Once per turn, one of your medical droids may deploy for 2 less.

'''Dark Side:'''
If you control this site and an Imperial is at this place, Force drain is +1.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is エコー基地医務室.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
